text:
jess: heads up — canary for release/1.12.3 showing a 2.8x increase in p99 for kv-heavy prompts vs yesterday. CI perf alert fired this morning. anyone on call to triage? :eyes:
ci-bot: PERF_ALERT: pipeline/perf-kvbench detected regression on build 2026-03-12-09: p50 +5%, p95 +40%, p99 +180% (compare to baseline 2026-03-10). Metrics: https://perf/redwood/kvbench/2026-03-12
ana: i'm on it. initial profiler traces show hot path stuck in kernel_selector::choose_kernel when seq_len spikes — sampling shows extra work in heuristics; looks like fallback to a slower kernel under some batched cases.
devon: just flagging PR 8703 (kernel-selector: prefer-lm8 heuristics) landed yesterday — might be the culprit. ana, can you bisect quick?
ana: starting git bisect on main between 6a1f2d..HEAD, running kvbench with seqlen=1024 concurrency=48. will post sha when reproduced.
kevin: also note PR 8721 changed kv-cache eviction to sample-based eviction thresholds (lowered warm cache retention) — could amplify kernel choice if cache misses increase. worth checking interaction.
sam: if both landed in same window that explains the big jump. recommend short-term mitigations: 1) disable adaptive kernel selector via env REDWOOD_KERNEL_ADAPTIVE=0 on canary; 2) revert the heuristics PR on release branch & cherry-pick if safe.
jess: agree. can we get a minimal patch to flip the env in the canary deploy? who owns the release pipeline?
devon: i can push an emergency config to canary. will update helm values and trigger a canary redeploy. command: ```./infra/deploy --env=canary --set runtime.env.REDWOOD_KERNEL_ADAPTIVE=false```
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/runtime -> image: runtime:1.12.3-canary-rollback-20260312 by devon
ci-bot: quick smoke perf run queued (kvbench small) — will report in ~10m.
maria: QA: once canary is up, please run regression profile and memory check. also need to verify no throughput drop for short-seq workloads.
ana: bisect results: bad commit is 9f4b2c7 (PR 8703). reverting that commit locally reproduces baseline perf.
devon: ok plan: revert 9f4b2c7 on release/1.12.x as hotfix, then cherry-pick adjusted heuristics back to main with tests. i'll prepare a revert PR and a backport.
sam: make sure to include a test that simulates mixed seqlen batching so we don't regress again. add a perf unit that runs kernel selector with varied batch sequences.
jess: owners: devon -> revert PR and canary deploy; ana -> run perf bench & profile; kevin -> audit PR 8721 kv-cache changes for interactions and prepare follow-up if needed; maria -> QA verify canary. target timeline: revert and canary verified in the next 2 hours if possible.
devon: created PR 8933: "revert(kernel-selector): revert 9f4b2c7 - emergency hotfix" and backport branch release/1.12.x. link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/8933
ci-bot: PR 8933 CI status: pending checks (unit, integrations, perf-smoke). perf-smoke queued.
nana: running the synthetic heavy-kv bench on canary once deploy finishes: ```scripts/perf/run_kvbench.sh --seqlen 1024 --concurrency 48 --duration 600```
deploy-bot: canary deploy completed: runtime pods rolled to runtime:1.12.3-canary-rollback-20260312 (8/8 ready)
ci-bot: perf-smoke for PR 8933 passed: p99 back within 5% of baseline.
maria: QA: verified memory and throughput on canary. no new OOMs, throughput stable for short seq tests. clearance to promote after release SIG +1. :+1:
jess: excellent. next steps: merge revert to release branch, cut hotpatch build, notify release team for controlled rollout. devon please coordinate cherry-pick of fixes to main with additional tests and a note describing the kv interaction.
devon: will merge revert to release/1.12.x once all checks pass and open a follow-up PR on main with improved heuristics + perf tests. tagging sam and kevin for review.
kevin: i'll audit kv-cache sampling thresholds and open PR if we need to tune retention to avoid miss storms when kernel selector flips.
sam: also propose adding a CI perf gate: run a small kvbench scenario on all PRs touching kernel_selector or kv-cache with p99 threshold alerts.
jess: +1 on CI gate. thanks everyone for the quick response. i'll update the release ticket and close the alert once hotpatch is cut. :heart:
